title: Napoleon Was Attacked by Rabbits (and Lost) 🐰
description:
In 1807 a rabbit hunt went wrong: the rabbits were tame farm rabbits, and they charged straight at Napoleon.

Sources: Mental Floss, "The Time Napoleon Was Attacked by Rabbits" · History Answers, "Napoleon's battle against rabbits" · General Thiébault's memoirs. Numbers vary by account, and the carriage detail is reported in later retellings.

title: This Jellyfish Can't Die of Old Age 🪼
description:
Turritopsis dohrnii can reverse its life cycle and become a baby again when it is hurt or starving - making it, in theory, biologically immortal.

Sources: Natural History Museum London · The Conversation · Hasegawa et al., DNA Research 2022 · BBC Wildlife. Some scenes are dramatized; in the wild it still gets eaten.

Voice is synthetic.

#jellyfish #science #shorts

title: This Cat Was Mayor of an Alaska Town for 20 Years 🐱
description:
Stubbs the cat was the honorary mayor of Talkeetna, Alaska, from 1997 until 2017, and tourists came every day just to meet him.

Sources: Wikipedia · AP / The Guardian · CNN · NPR · BBC
